function.name: get_latest_cost_anomalies
function.description: Returns the full current cost signal picture across all tracked subscriptions, services, and metrics (EffectiveCost, BilledCost). Each signal includes its statistics (mean, std_dev, iqr_bounds), the most recent value and date, and a list of any anomalies currently flagged for that signal. Signals with too few data points instead carry a 'note' explaining that statistics aren't available yet. Use this for a broad view of everything being tracked, not just what's currently flagged.

function.name: get_cost_anomaly_history
function.description: Returns only the signals currently flagged as anomalous, each annotated with persistence_days — the number of consecutive snapshots that signal has stayed flagged. Use this to assess how sustained a given anomaly is, rather than treating every flagged signal as equally urgent.

lookback_days.description: How many days of history to check when computing persistence. Pass null to use the server-side configured default (currently 14).

function.name: get_security_recommendations
function.description: Returns currently open (unhealthy) Microsoft Defender for Cloud security recommendations across every subscription this tool has visibility into. Each recommendation includes which subscription it applies to, its name, severity, and category. Recommendations that are already resolved are not included. Use this to ground the security/risk side of a trade-off in actual posture data rather than general assumption.

function.name: get_advisor_recommendations
function.description: Returns currently active Azure Advisor recommendations across every subscription this tool has visibility into, covering the Cost, Reliability, OperationalExcellence, and Performance categories. Note: the Reliability category appears in the data with the value 'HighAvailability', not 'Reliability' — Advisor's underlying data uses this older internal name even though the Portal displays 'Reliability'; treat 'HighAvailability' as meaning Reliability. Advisor's own Security category is deliberately excluded — get_security_recommendations (backed by Microsoft Defender for Cloud) is the reliable source for security posture instead. Each recommendation includes its category, impact (High/Medium/Low), a description, the specific resource it applies to, and — for Cost recommendations specifically — a quantified potential savings amount and currency where Advisor has calculated one. Recommendations that are postponed, dismissed, or completed are not included.
